verdict.rationale: Postman's docs say team workspaces let members "share, version, and discuss their work," and the collaboration docs reference commenting on APIs. That gives thin first-party evidence of versioning and review for collections, the closest thing to automations here. Nothing documents rolling back an automation, and the versioning mention is a single line with no detail on version history or diffs. Missing for 10: documented rollback/restore of prior versions, detailed version-history and diff docs for collections or flows, a review/approval workflow for automation changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Create internal workspaces, where team members can share, version, and discuss their work and collaborate on API projects.
